build_data_loader: build a PyTorch DataLoader with detectron2 TrainingSampler or InferenceSampler for ImageNet classification
create_ClassificationNet: create a ClassificationNet wrapper around a torchvision ResNet model for ImageNet training
create_ClassificationAcc: create a ClassificationAcc evaluator to compute top-1 accuracy across distributed GPUs
run_imagenet_training: run ImageNet classification training with ResNet-50 using detectron2 lazyconfig and 8 GPUs
configure_lr_scheduler: configure a WarmupParamScheduler with MultiStepParamScheduler for learning rate decay at epoch milestones
